message.content:
**Paris Get‑Away Plan (7 Days)**  
*(Feel free to tweak dates, budget, or interests – this is a flexible template.)*

---

## Day 1 – Arrival & Settling In  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 08:00 | Arrive at Charles de Gaulle / Orly | Take the RER B or Roissybus to your hotel. |
| 10:30 | Check‑in & freshen up | Choose a boutique hotel in Le Marais, Saint‑Germain‑des‑Près, or near the Louvre for easy access. |
| 12:00 | Lunch at **Café Charlot** | Classic French bistro, great croissants and a view of the street. |
| 14:00 | Walk along the Seine | Stop by the **Bouquinistes** (second‑hand book stalls) and enjoy river views. |
| 16:00 | Visit the **Louvre Museum** (if you’re a first‑time visitor) | Book tickets online to skip the line. |
| 19:30 | Dinner at **Le Comptoir du Relais** | Try duck confit or steak frites. |
| 21:30 | Evening stroll to the **Eiffel Tower** | Light show at 20:45 (check schedule). |

---

## Day 2 – Classic Landmarks  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 09:00 | Breakfast at **Du Pain et des Idées** | Famous for pain au chocolat. |
| 10:00 | Notre‑Dame Cathedral & Île de la Cité | Explore the cathedral’s interior and the nearby **Sainte‑Chapelle**. |
| 12:30 | Lunch at **Le Petit Cler** | Traditional French fare in a charming market street. |
| 14:00 | Walk to the **Arc de Triomphe** | Climb to the top for panoramic city views. |
| 15:30 | Champs‑Élysées shopping | Browse flagship stores or stop at **Ladurée** for macarons. |
| 18:00 | Seine River cruise (Bateaux Mouches) | Sunset cruise gives a different perspective of landmarks. |
| 20:30 | Dinner at **Septime** (reservation required) | Modern French cuisine; book months ahead. |

---

## Day 3 – Art & Culture  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 09:00 | Breakfast at **Café de Flore** | Iconic left‑wing café. |
| 10:30 | Musée d’Orsay | Impressionist masterpieces; pre‑book tickets. |
| 13:00 | Picnic in the Tuileries Garden | Grab baguette, cheese, and wine from a local shop. |
| 15:00 | Visit the **Centre Pompidou** | Contemporary art; rooftop terrace offers great city views. |
| 18:00 | Attend a performance at the **Opéra Garnier** | Check schedule for ballet, opera, or classical concerts. |
| 21:00 | Late‑night snack at **L’As du Fallafel** | Famous falafel in Le Marais. |

---

## Day 4 – Day Trip to Versailles  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 07:30 | Early breakfast at hotel | Pack a small bag. |
| 08:30 | Take the RER C to Versailles Château | Tickets include train and palace entry. |
| 10:00 | Tour the Palace & Hall of Mirrors | Guided audio tour recommended. |
| 12:30 | Lunch at **La Petite Venise** | Italian‑French fusion near the palace. |
| 14:00 | Explore the Gardens & Trianon Palaces | Rent a bike or take a guided walk. |
| 17:00 | Return to Paris | Relax at your hotel. |
| 20:00 | Dinner at **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** | Famous for steak frites and secret sauce. |

---

## Day 5 – Montmartre & Nightlife  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 09:00 | Breakfast at **Le Pain Quotidien** | Organic bakery. |
| 10:30 | Explore Montmartre | Visit Sacré‑Coeur, Place du Tertre, and the artists’ square. |
| 13:00 | Lunch at **La Maison Rose** | Quaint spot with a view of the city. |
| 15:00 | Visit the **Espace Dalí** | Surrealist art in Montmartre. |
| 17:30 | Return to hotel & rest | |
| 19:30 | Dinner at **Le Cinq** (Four‑star Michelin) | For a splurge; book well in advance. |
| 22:00 | Night out at **Rex Club** or **Concrete** | Experience Parisian nightlife. |

---

## Day 6 – Shopping & Hidden Gems  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 09:00 | Breakfast at **Café Kitsuné** | Trendy café in Jardin du Palais‑Royal. |
| 10:30 | Shopping in Le Marais | Boutiques, vintage shops, and concept stores. |
| 12:30 | Lunch at **L’Avant‑Garde** | Contemporary French cuisine. |
| 14:00 | Visit the **Musée Picasso** | Explore Picasso’s works in a historic mansion. |
| 16:00 | Explore Canal Saint‑Martin | Coffee at **Café du Poisson Rouge**. |
| 18:30 | Sunset at the **Pont Alexandre III** | Stunning bridge with ornate lamps. |
| 20:00 | Dinner at **Le Relais de l’Entrecôte** (again) | Or try **Septime La Cave** for a wine‑centric dinner. |

---

## Day 7 – Departure & Last‑Minute Souvenirs  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| 08:00 | Breakfast at hotel | |
| 09:30 | Quick visit to **Marché aux Puces de Saint‑Ouen** | Flea market for antiques and vintage finds. |
| 12:00 | Lunch at **Le Petit Cler** (again) | Or grab a quick sandwich from a boulangerie. |
| 13:30 | Head to airport | Use RER B or taxi; allow extra time for security. |

---

### Practical Tips

| Category | Recommendation |
|----------|----------------|
| **Transport** | Purchase a **Paris Visite** pass (zones 1‑3) for unlimited metro, bus, and RER within central Paris. |
| **Accommodation** | Stay in a boutique hotel or Airbnb in Le Marais, Saint‑Germain‑des‑Près, or near the Louvre for convenience. |
| **Dining** | Reserve tables at high‑profile restaurants (Septime, Le Cinq) months ahead. |
| **Tickets** | Buy museum and attraction tickets online to avoid queues. |
| **Language** | Basic French phrases help; most staff speak English. |
| **Weather** | Pack layers; Paris weather can be unpredictable. |
| **Safety** | Keep valuables secure; pickpocketing can occur in crowded tourist spots. |

Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like a more tailored itinerary (budget, specific interests, or alternative dates), just let me know.
